title: Contract run
description: One run of a slot's contract test against one filler (scripts/contract.sh): what was checked, pass or fail.

interface.description: the API whose contract it is, e.g. secrets-api

filler.description: what filled the slot for the run, e.g. env or openbao

checks.description: each check: its name, ok, and why not

failed.description: the names of the checks that failed
